question: Does the component ATtiny45-20P have a minimum voltage of 1.8V according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: According to the ATtiny45-20P datasheet (http://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/atmel-2586-avr-8-bit-microcontroller-attiny25-attiny45-attiny85_datasheet.pdf), the ATtiny45 operates with a supply voltage range of 1.8V to 5.5V, so the minimum voltage is indeed 1.8V.
